1.
 
 This memo gives guidance on the Universal Credit (Removal of Two Child Limit) Act 2026, which 
comes into force on 6.4.26.
1

1. 
UC (Removal of Two Child Limit) Act s1

2. Since 6 April 2017 the child element (CE) of Universal Credit (UC) has been awarded only in respect 
of the first and second child or QYP for whom the claimant is responsible, unless an exception 
applies. (the two-child limit)
1

3. From 6.4.26 that limit is removed and a CE will be payable in respect of any child or QYP the claimant 
is responsible for. (ADM 
F1056
) The ordering of children and QYPs, and whether any exceptions 
apply, no longer needs to be considered.

4. An amount in respect of any child or QYP for whom the claimant is responsible will be included in their 
award of UC in the AP commencing on or after the 6.4.26
1
.
UC(Removal of 2 child limit) Act, s1(4).

6. However, the two-child limit must still be applied when considering entitlement to a CE for any period 
prior to 6.4.26.

Please annotate this Memo at the side of the following ADM paragraph: 
F1004

If you have any queries about this memo, please write to Decision Making and Appeals (DMA) Leeds, 
3E zone E, Quarry House, Leeds. Existing arrangements for such referrals should be followed, as set 
out in – Memo 
7/19
 Requesting case guidance from DMA Leeds for all benefits.
